description: Latest iDevice news about one product, each story with the sources it rests on. Newest first: the title, the date, the story page on idevice.com, a one-line summary, the kind of story (standalone or cluster) and the outlets and links it is based on (outlet, URL, date). The same stories as the News tab on the product's Guide. Optional limit (default 5, at most 15) and since (YYYY-MM-DD); a company_key returns a company's news instead. A story with no source link says so.

company_key.description: A company key such as 'apple' or 'samsung', instead of a product_slug

since.description: Only stories published on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_product_news
title: Latest news about a product
